summary: High-stayed hooks (>50% stayed_pct) deliver a sharp, counter-intuitive fact or second-person premise within the first 10 words (e.g., 'A car that folds up... keeps you safer').
Low-stayed videos (<40% stayed_pct) fail early because hooks use slow background setup or vague intro statements ('Pluto seemed like...', 'Most images hold secrets...').
Winning topics focus on visceral car physics, extreme T. rex mechanics, or hidden body quirks, whereas niche engineering details (guardrail boxes) and abstract astronomy stall early.
High-stayed titles frame direct visual comparisons or clear cause-and-effect questions with relevant emojis ('Why Double Speed Means 4x Braking Distance 🚗').
To break the 1,200-view ceiling, videos must achieve >50% stayed_pct by replacing scenario-building text with immediate, high-contrast visual statements.
winning_hooks: Direct second-person callouts: 'Your eyes are leaking right now, and your brain is hiding it.' (52.0% stayed)
Immediate counter-intuitive rule: 'A car that folds up in a crash keeps you safer than one that doesn't.' (59.6% stayed)
Instant myth-busting statement: 'The real T. rex probably couldn't run. Not even a jog.' (52.4% stayed)
Extreme scale comparison: 'Drive twice as fast, and your car needs four times as far to stop.' (55.4% stayed)
avoid: Vague context-setting statements: 'Most James Webb images hold secrets.' (30.2% stayed)
Hypotheticals that set up a scenario before reaching the point: 'Your car swerves off the highway right toward...' (30.4% stayed)
Textbook background preamble: 'Pluto seemed like our solar system's edge, yet astronomers are investigating...' (44.3% stayed)
Passive observation statements: 'Your frozen pond is secretly keeping fish alive.' (24.2% stayed)
next_experiment: A/B test the same topic (e.g., 'Why airplane windows have tiny holes') using Hook A (Scenario Setup: 'Imagine flying at 30,000 feet and looking at a tiny hole in your window') vs Hook B (Immediate Contrast Statement: 'That tiny hole in your airplane window is the only thing keeping the glass from shattering'). Measure stayed_pct baseline against the 50% feed threshold.
